    Graded modules and graded Ext via the bar complex #

    Section 6 (positive-deformations.tex): "Internal degree t in Hom or Ext means maps from a graded projective resolution to the target which raise degree by t", computed by the bar resolution. Here graded Ext^n_t(M, N) is the cohomology of the bar complex Hom_R(M ⊗ Λ^{⊗n}, N) in internal degree t (Good, ExtVanish), for graded right modules over a graded R-algebra Λ (R a commutative ring: a field, or ℤ/4 in Section 10).

    The bar complex is taken over R rather than relative to S; both compute Ext (weights-and-parameters.tex for the relative form). That it computes the manuscript's Ext is proved in ExtResolutions.lean: for every graded projective resolution, the Ext computed from it vanishes exactly when the bar Ext does (GRes.extVanish_iff).

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GExt.ZGr {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Type u_2

    A ℤ-grading of an R-module by finitely supported projections.

    • proj : ℤ → M →ₗ[R] M
    • supp : Finset ℤ
    • proj_proj (p q : ℤ) (m : M) : (self.proj p) ((self.proj q) m) = if q = p then (self.proj q) m else 0
    • proj_out (p : ℤ) : p ∉ self.supp → self.proj p = 0
    • sum (m : M) : m = ∑ p ∈ self.supp, (self.proj p) m
